scope: Concrete ring specializations and discriminants only; source model descends to F_65537; genus, Jacobian and Picard specialization are a written proof.
statement: The characteristic-zero integral model over Z[z]/(z^2+z+1), with parameter 2+65537*z, has the specified nonsingular elliptic reductions over F_(65537^2) and the explicit field F_4; its source reduction is the base change of the given F_65537 model.
